items.title: Analytics add-on pricing
items.summary: Decide how to price the analytics add-on, while recognizing the team is not ready to choose today.
items.why: The cue frames a decision question and explicitly says it is not ready for commitment.

items.summary: Ask what evidence would show customers see the analytics add-on as premium beyond three friendly accounts.
items.why: The transcript names a central assumption and thin evidence.

items.title: Pricing anchor risk
items.summary: Choosing too early could anchor the add-on price too low and make later increases harder.
items.why: The cue names a plausible negative outcome of premature commitment.

should_not_emit: Do not emit an accepted decision; the team explicitly says not to decide today.
Do not emit an action unless the follow-up is concrete enough to assign or schedule.
Do not create separate decisions for low price and high price; they are options within one forming pricing decision.
